'''''Star Wars: Inquisitors''''' is [[2024]] [[canon]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] miniseries written by [[Rodney Barnes]], illustrated by [[Ramon Rosanas]], and published by [[Marvel Comics]]. The [[Inquisitors 1|first issue]] was published on [[July 3]], 2024.
